items.title: Top 5 Problems Clinical Diagnostics Companies Face and How Scispot Helps Solve Them
items.summary: Clinical diagnostics teams usually do not break because of one missing feature. They struggle when sample tracking, intake, instrument data, reporting, and compliance evidence live in different places. Across several Scispot customers, the same five problems surfaced repeatedly: fragmented chain of custody, manual intake, instrument-to-workflow gaps, audit burden, and software that does not match real lab work. This post lays out those five problems and shows how Scispot helps labs connect sample movement, operational workflows, instrument outputs, and compliance records in one system. The examples cover PCR and qPCR workflows, regulated and near-regulated environments, high-throughput batch operations, and diagnostics teams trying to move beyond spreadsheet-heavy processes.
